name: Cloud Infrastructure Artifact Analysis
description: Ability to analyse cloud infrastructure artifacts beyond logs. Covers VM disk snapshot forensics, serverless function analysis, storage bucket metadata, IAM policy reconstruction, infrastructure-as-code history, and cloud-native database forensics. Addresses the ephemeral nature of cloud resources and strategies for evidence preservation.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to cloud infrastructure artifact analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands what forensic artifacts exist in cloud infrastructure beyond logs
evidence: Can describe cloud infrastructure artifacts (VM snapshots, storage metadata, IAM configurations)
Understands the ephemeral nature of cloud resources and its forensic implications
Can explain why traditional disk forensics alone is insufficient for cloud investigations

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Collects and examines cloud infrastructure artifacts under supervision
evidence: Acquired and mounted VM disk snapshots from AWS EBS or Azure Managed Disks under guidance
Examined S3 bucket or Azure Blob versioning and access logs
Reviewed IAM policies and role trust relationships to understand access patterns
Documented cloud artifact collection with supervisor review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently collects and analyses cloud infrastructure artifacts to support forensic investigations
evidence: Independently analysed cloud infrastructure artifacts in 5+ investigations
Performed forensic analysis of VM disk snapshots including OS artifact extraction
Reconstructed IAM policy changes and permission modifications from cloud history
Preserved serverless function code and configuration as evidence before resource termination

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex multi-account cloud investigations; analyses managed-service, database, and infrastructure-as-code artifacts; develops collection automation
evidence: Investigated incidents spanning multiple cloud accounts and organisations
Recovered evidence from cloud-native databases and infrastructure-as-code state or history (e.g. Terraform state, CloudFormation stack events)
Developed automated cloud artifact collection tools using cloud-native APIs
Mentors junior analysts on cloud infrastructure forensic techniques

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines cloud artifact analysis methodology; researches new cloud forensic artifacts; advises on cloud forensic readiness architecture
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's cloud infrastructure forensic methodology
Published research on cloud-specific forensic artifacts or collection techniques
Advises organisations on cloud architecture decisions for forensic readiness
Trains teams on cloud infrastructure forensics across multiple providers

assessment_methods.description: Given access to a compromised cloud environment, identify and collect relevant infrastructure artifacts, analyse VM snapshots, and produce a forensic report
Presented with a scenario where cloud resources have been terminated, determine what artifacts remain available and develop a collection strategy
